notes: Both source titles and DOIs verified in the full texts. Original locator p.5 contains several tests; the direct five-year-old versus adult age comparison was selected because it explicitly matches the neutral description. It concerns absolutely equal trials, whereas the replication age comparison concerns conflict trials; these are related age contrasts but not identical trial designs. No test statistic or named effect size is printed for the replication pairwise contrast, so es is null; omnibus F statistics involving seven-year-olds were not substituted. Original chi-square glyph is rendered v2 by PDF text extraction. Replication sample quote for adults is separately present as: and 14 undergraduate students. Exclusions are not specified, rather than established to be zero. Replication was verified from complete PMC HTML; exact section and paragraph locations are supplied because pagination cannot be verified from that format. The PMC PDF alternative returned non-PDF content and was not retried.
